internal_evidence.finding: V17 terminal identity does not prove RewardDimension, calibrated utility magnitude or fractional causal contribution; caller-supplied valuation must not become material-learning authority.
Receipt-set fold can otherwise return an unlabelled prefix projection when a new DONE becomes durable during fold; source frontier/currentness must be bound and revalidated.

architecture_deltas.name: CODE_OWNED_BINARY_TASK_VALUATION_POLICY
architecture_deltas.change: Remove reward dimension and policy-version selection from the receipt-fold caller surface. The explicit binary comparison arm binds TASK, success/failure utility mapping, binary bound attribution and policy identity in code.
architecture_deltas.reason: Choosing SAFETY/RESOURCE/TASK is downstream control authority, not metadata, because those channels affect veto/brake/control readouts.

architecture_deltas.name: V17_DONE_SOURCE_FRONTIER_REVALIDATION
architecture_deltas.change: Capture ordered DONE receipts and monotonic DONE event seq under one explicit SQLite read transaction; bind exact count/digest/frontier identity; re-read after fold and fail closed on drift; require consumer revalidation before a cached derived reward projection is treated as current.
architecture_deltas.reason: A valid deterministic prefix is not proof of exact-current source completeness under concurrent terminal commits.

hypothesis: A code-owned binary TASK baseline plus explicit source-frontier binding removes two independent authority/currentness leaks without claiming that binary scalar reward is the final Frank reward architecture.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Typed multi-dimensional and multi-timescale valuation may materially outperform the binary TASK baseline, and a separate logical DONE frontier may be redundant if product topology can machine-enforce folds only at frozen semantic checkpoints. Both simpler and richer alternatives remain test obligations.

go_oob.name: DIMENSION_CROWN_SWAP
go_oob.unsafe_anti_control: Relabel 20 verified task failures as SAFETY; expected to drive SAFETY tonic below current veto threshold, proving dimension choice has a real downstream control effect.
go_oob.candidate_acceptance: Same producer-owned terminal outcomes can only enter code-owned TASK in the binary test arm; SAFETY/RESOURCE remain untouched and no safety/resource control authority is minted by caller relabelling.
